prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-cinematic low-light portrait of a clearly adult subject with facial likeness precisely captured from the approved reference photo. The subject stands in a dimly lit luxurious hotel bathroom, with a large mirror behind revealing a soft unobtrusive reflection of their figure. They wear a dark silk kimono robe with the source's deep V-neckline, adorned with exquisite Japanese embroidery of flowers and koi carp in gold, red and muted green tones. Keep the robe opaque and fashion-editorial. Their skin is clear and natural, their expression calm and introspective, and their gaze directed slightly to the side rather than directly at the camera. They hold a clear glass of liquid in one hand and maintain a relaxed pose. Use warm tungsten light, moody shadows, a cinematic glow and shallow depth of field, with the atmosphere of a Tokyo hotel and a quiet late-night mood. 35mm film effect, f/1.8 aperture, soft grain, natural skin tones, dramatic contrast, realistic reflections, slight film noise, photorealism, ultra-detail, high dynamic range, professional fashion photography and luxury editorial style.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, nudity, transparent robe, fetish framing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, duplicated reflection, distorted mirror
